body:
MAINLINE-023 checked independently, covering both filings. The load fix passes: 665 numeric fields and 196 display/report comparisons reproduce, including all 43 engineering quantities preserved in the first report. Its five original artifact paths were overwritten; original full tables cannot be checked against their pins. Corrected pins match.

Equilateral equilibrium gives 562166.272760 N at s=2.04 m. The superseded 973700.546722 N explains the original figures. Corrected re-closed masses: titanium 157.685365 kg, Invar 858.578420 kg, brazed wall extension 130.611003 kg, CFRP 31.038987 kg. The sleeve totals are independent of spacing at held radius. Searches reproduce the wrap's shell-only factors 1.465814527 at k 0.2 and 2.060754083 at k 0.4; the corrected five-percent search gives 1.406143581 at s 1.78 m.

The joint-inclusive interpretation needs qualification: bonds/end sections are sized to nominal SF 1, while the reported least factor covers six shell modes. Central node mass and rotational stiffness, adhesive and braze-receiver mass, and coupon transfer remain unresolved. The braze coefficient's units are kg/(N*m), not 1/N. The reference pin's 3d length cannot span the tube diameter.

Primary material sources checked. The wrap remains the lightest partial end-material estimate and a PROJECTION. Eleven nonblocking NFI records include the resolved force error. CHECK.md gives derivations, exact comparisons and source limits. No successor job is named.
